content: The administration of amlodipine alongside digoxin did not alter serum digoxin levels or the renal clearance of digoxin in healthy volunteers. Ethanol (alcohol): Single and multiple 10 mg doses of amlodipine did not have any significant impact on the pharmacokinetics of ethanol. Warfarin: Co-administration of amlodipine with warfarin did not affect the prothrombin response time associated with warfarin. CYP3A4 Inhibitors: When a daily dose of 180 mg of diltiazem was co-administered with 5 mg of amlodipine in elderly hypertensive patients, there was a 60% increase in the systemic exposure to amlodipine. However, co-administration of erythromycin with amlodipine in healthy volunteers did not significantly alter amlodipine's systemic exposure. Other strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (e.g., ketoconazole, itraconazole, ritonavir) may substantially increase the plasma concentrations of amlodipine. It is recommended to monitor for symptoms of hypotension and edema when amlodipine is co-administered with CYP3A4 inhibitors. CYP3A4 Inducers: There is no available data on the quantitative effects of CYP3A4 inducers on amlodipine. Blood pressure should be closely monitored when amlodipine is co-administered with CYP3A4 inducers.
